responsibility: Defines the inference-engine error reporting layer on `TypeErrCtxt`, turning type and region inference failures into structured diagnostics, suppressing cascaded errors involving the error type, classifying compared type categories, and coordinating specialized submodules for notes, suggestions, region errors, and missing type information.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the inference-diagnostics implementation module: it adds the concrete `TypeErrCtxt` methods for mismatched types and region/type inference errors, sitting below top-level `error_reporting/mod.rs` and separate from trait-selection or query infrastructure.
